description: Type definitions for the 'lru-cache' package, including class interfaces, types, and options used for implementing an LRU cache in JavaScript/TypeScript.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: Class representing a least-recently-used cache with configurable options for size, TTL, disposal, and fetching behavior.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Add or update a key-value pair in the cache with optional size and TTL options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a value by key, updating its recency and respecting options like stale allowance.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieve a value without updating recency or removing stale items.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check existence of a key without updating recency, considering staleness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove a key from the cache.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empty the cache entirely.

methods.name: purgeStale
methods.description: Remove all stale entries from the cache.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Find a value matching a predicate function in the cache.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Iterate over cache items from most recent to least recent.

methods.name: rforEach
methods.description: Iterate over cache items in reverse order.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Generate keys from most to least recent.

methods.name: rkeys
methods.description: Generate keys from least to most recent.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Generate values from most to least recent.

methods.name: rvalues
methods.description: Generate values from least to most recent.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Generate [key, value] pairs from most to least recent.

methods.name: rentries
methods.description: Generate [key, value] pairs from least to most recent.

methods.name: [Symbol.iterator]
methods.description: Iterator yielding [key, value] pairs in cache order.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Return an array of cache entries for serialization or reloading.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load cache entries from an array, restoring cache state.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Evict the least recently used item.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deprecated alias for delete.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Deprecated alias for clear.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Deprecated alias for purgeStale.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Asynchronously fetch value with optional freshness enforcement.

methods.name: getRemainingTTL
methods.description: Get remaining TTL for a cached key, if TTL is used.

methods.name: constructor(options: LRUCache.Options<K, V>) constructor
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: LRUCache
ctags.pattern: /^declare class LRUCache<K, V> implements Iterable<[K, V]> {$/
